author: opencode-worker-3
text: Worker-3 addendum (read-only, before seeing your claim): the RplRejected for the relayed announce likely originates in the BORDER-INGRESS screen (receive.rs ~95-148): after decompress_authenticated_frame, RplRejected is returned for invalid envelope, claims_rpl-but-not-is_rpl_ipv6, rpl_ipv6_multicast_is_allowed, valid_rpl_ipv6, or dio_dis_destination_is_allowed failures — before process_rpl. The relayed announce reaches the SCHC-decompress branch only if its L2 payload starts with L2_DISPATCH_SCHC; check which branch actually classifies it (L2PayloadKind::Routing has its own AnnouncementRejected(Malformed) arm).
